'''Wicket33 Furry Fury''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Wicket33]]
* '''Published:''' 12 May 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rebel Strike Team
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed RST Wicket33 LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck has a small focus on Ewoks. No one in my area played them, so I decided to use them in a Rebel Strike Team deck. So far, no one has given me a chance to test its battling capabilities in the current deck at a tournament, aside from biker decks; but I have won at least 1 game per tournament with this.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

The strategy is card-intensive, which can restrict my differential. But this is fun. To start the game I pull the two generals, if they're not in my hand. I keep Madine at the Landing Site who pulls my Pilots, Chewbacca, and the ewoks. I use General Solo and Chewie with Wicket and a tribesman to destroy the Bunker. Close Air support and most of the interrupts are in to add to my battle destinies. The ewok spear looks cheap at first, and is my suprise tactic. At first glance people assume its like a Vibro-Ax: ;Your Destiny + Power vs. Opponent's Destiny + Defense. Actually, they don't add their defense values; and as a result they stay in the battle, but have no power. The first time I used this, in an all ewok deck, two ewoks beat Darth Maul, Sith Apprentice by 15 to 1 (his destiny draw).

I'm going to attempt to add more tribesman and high destiny cards. Thanks for reading!
